docs.description: Spanning event bar used in the all-day row at the top of the Week / Day grid, and for multi-day events that span columns in the Month grid. Span variants control the corner radii so consecutive segments can fuse into a single bar across columns.

rules.reason: An event that spans a day or more, as the description says: a bar in a week or day grid's all-day row, or across a month grid's columns, as a stripe beside neutral words (subtle) or a full fill with inverse words (solid), its time ("All day") and its title. Its `span` says which segment of a bar across columns it is. A styled part, as the calendar family is (decision): what the event is, and what a click on it does, are the caller's.

Rule 5's one exception, as Alert's and Event Chip's (owner decision 2026-09-25): `style` is React's inline-style prop, so no component can take it, and `variant` names the look on both platforms. The design review asks Figma to rename the property `variant`, so the names match.
Figma aligns a solid bar's content to its top where a subtle bar's is centred; the content fills the bar's height, so neither draws the difference, as an Event Chip's tinted one.

A subtle bar is square beside its stripe (radius.none); a solid bar, a filled box, is rounded (radius.control), as Figma draws each. Figma draws every span alike, though the description says the span sets the corners so segments fuse; the design review asks.
The stripe runs the bar's height in a subtle bar. A solid bar hides it, and no prop shows it there, so what Figma keeps on it there (a fixed 25, no radius) is never drawn.
